kebab_example: aliyun btripopen intl-flight-listing-search --search-mode 0 --out-wheel-search false --search-journeys '[{"arr_city_code":"MEL","dep_city_code":"HKG","dep_date":"2023-12-28","selected_flights":[{}]}]' --trip-type 1 --cabin-type 0 --isv-name TEST --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: IntlFlightListingSearch

parameters.help_en:
The search mode. Default value: 0.</br>
Valid values: OUTBOUND(0, "outbound"), INBOUND(1, "inbound").</br>
One-way: always 0. Round-trip: outbound-0, return-1. Multi-city: first leg-0, subsequent legs-1
parameters.help_zh:
搜索模式，默认0。</br>
枚举：OUTBOUND(0, "去程"),INBOUND(1, "回程")。</br>
单程：都是0；往返：去程-0，返程-1；多程：第一程-0，此后都是1
parameters.name: search_mode

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable external polling. When the external frontend controls polling, more flights are returned. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 外部轮询，外部前端自己控制轮询，会返回更多航班，默认false
parameters.name: out_wheel_search

parameters.help_en:
The query record ID, used for external polling.

<notice>

This field takes effect only when out_wheel_search is set to true.
Do not pass a value for the first search. Otherwise, no search results are returned.
For each subsequent polling request, pass the query_record_id returned from the previous response. Otherwise, no search results are returned.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
查询记录id，用于外部轮询

<notice>

该字段仅当 out_wheel_search 为 true 时生效；
第一次搜索不支持传值，否则无搜索结果；
后续每次轮询需传入上一次返回的 query_record_id，否则无搜索结果；
</notice>
parameters.name: query_record_id

parameters.help_en:
The query record token, used for external polling.

<notice>

This field takes effect only when out_wheel_search is set to true.
Do not pass a value for the first search. Otherwise, no search results are returned.
For each subsequent polling request, pass the token returned from the previous response. Otherwise, no search results are returned.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
查询记录token，用于外部轮询

<notice>

该字段仅当 out_wheel_search 为 true 时生效；
第一次搜索时不支持传值，否则无搜索结果；
后续每次轮询需传入上一次返回的 token，否则无搜索结果；
</notice>

When calling this operation over HTTP, include this as a required parameter in the request URL. For information about how to obtain the token, refer to Enterprise access token (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.5e2a281frQyDQ8&docId=3769985).
